sources.access: from OSM access=* tag (private/customers/members → private; yes/public → public; else unknown)
sources.notes: Deduped against DNR/rec within ~120 m. Untagged slipways labeled unknown. Private club launches not in OSM/state inventories are intentionally omitted.

caveats: Private launch coverage is limited to sites published in the state recreational facilities inventory or OSM with access=private/customers/members.
Do not treat private/commercial markers as guaranteed guest access — confirm with the operator.
No gated club directories were scraped; absence of a private ramp does not mean none exist.
